name: Caro-Kann Defense
description: A solid defense to 1.e4 where Black supports a later d5 center break.

moves.explanation: White takes space in the center.
Black prepares d5 while keeping a sturdy pawn structure.
White builds a broad pawn center.
Black challenges the center with support from the c6 pawn.

ideas: Develop the light-squared bishop before locking it in when possible.
Aim for a solid structure and clear piece development.
commonMistakes: Playing passively after building the pawn structure.
Trapping the c8 bishop behind e6 too early.
